part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the end and is now resting in front of the red wall, about 0.7 m away according to its sonar.

The corridor had four turns: left, right, left, then left again into the last section, which ended at the red wall. The robot walked about 17 m without bumping into anything or falling. It told the people nearby that it had arrived, then crouched and turned its motors off.
